prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1162; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in Pasadena, Texas, I observed two vehicles in the roadway with significant front-end damage to both. Driver 1 was operating the northbound vehicle and Driver 2 was operating the southbound vehicle. Based on vehicle positions and debris, the two vehicles collided head-on in the northbound lane at low speed. Both drivers stated that they had been traveling at approximately 20 miles per hour prior to impact. A passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of the northbound vehicle and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the right knee and stated that the knee struck the dashboard during the collision. Driver 1 was able to exit the vehicle with assistance and was evaluated on scene before declining transport. Airbags did not deploy in either vehicle. Both vehicles were towed from the scene due to damage. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry at the time of the incident.
